xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
This is not a guarantee against every stale response: saveReels returns void and the reader can still use its already-read snapshot.
The pictured alt is scoped to an existing tombstone. For non-tombstone values, currentVersion > incomingVersion also rejects.
Invalidation failure retains local quarantine; successful newer fill clears it.
